vision: A distributable library of AI coding assistant rules, skills, hooks, and an adversarial verification harness for Cursor and Claude Code. The library must dogfood its own authoring standards: every rule, skill, and validation gate should pass before the library is considered trustworthy.
direction: library/cursor/ is the single source of truth for distributable config. .cursor/ is local-only (gitignored, created via make setup). Validation (make validate) must pass with zero errors. Eval pipeline (Tier 1 static + Tier 3 session 27 scenarios) at 85% (362/424 checks). LLM judge tier operational. Phase 1 judge tuning applied (expanded behavioral regexes, lowered session boundary threshold). Next: re-run evals to measure impact, then Phase 2 — gap-13 (contract skipping) and gap-14 (session boundary enforcement) via rule/skill structural changes.
